0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, 0-4 on the road, on a seven-game losing streak) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, on a three-game winning streak) for the Jazz's 10th game of the season, with Utah 14th in the West and Minnesota 5th. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), while Keyonte George (illness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Jazz lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 147-111 Jazz loss in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
